title: God's many ways of speaking and the moral medicine of Psalm 36
english: God spoke to the fathers in the prophets in many parts and in many ways (Hebrews 1:1). Sometimes he teaches ineffable mysteries; sometimes he instructs about the Savior; sometimes he corrects behavior. The whole of Psalm 36 is moral—care and medicine of the human soul. Its beginning: Do not envy among the wicked, nor envy those who do iniquity; for like hay they will quickly wither, and like herbs of the field they will quickly fall (Psalm 37:1-2, LXX 36:1-2).

title: Envy as provocation of a jealous God
english: To envy someone is also to irritate and to provoke. In Deuteronomy it says: They themselves brought me into jealousy with what is not God, and I will bring them into jealousy (Deuteronomy 32:21). The Apostle asks: Or do we envy the Lord? (1 Corinthians 10:22). Our God is a jealous God (Exodus 20:5). The one who sins incites the jealous God into jealousy.

title: Hope in the Lord and the land as the heart
english: Hope in the Lord and do goodness; inhabit the land and you will be fed in his riches (Psalm 37:3). This land is the heart of the hearer, the fields of the soul. Delight in the Lord, and he will give you the requests of your heart (Psalm 37:4). Reveal your way to the Lord and hope in him. He will bring out your righteousness like light (Psalm 37:5-6). Glory to Christ. Amen.
